description: Tsunami-HySEA is a GPU-based numerical model from the EDANYA group at the University of Malaga that simulates tsunamis generated by earthquakes or landslides using shallow-water equations, with single-layer and multi-layer variants. The project page describes it as high-performance software and offers access to the group's GPU cluster for users without their own hardware; the developers will also run simulations for outside users. There is a benchmark section on the US National Tsunami Hazard Mitigation Program tests. Access is by contacting the developers, and the page states neither a licence nor a price, so it is treated as on request. Input and output formats are not described on the page read on 2026-09-29, and the model was not run. Coverage is any coastline with elevation data. Caveats: no public source repository was found on the project page, and running large domains needs GPUs. It suits coastal hazard exposure and emergency planning for ports, coastal roads and energy sites. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
